sfx_review.note: Harmonic stack of short tonal notes repeating on a regular grid across the whole window; part of the melodic music bed, not a discrete chime tied to a visual.

pattern.description: Opening shot: letterboxed low-angle stock footage of a glass skyscraper with a slow, continuous camera pull-out and slight tilt, under a soft plucked music bed before the first spoken line.
pattern.why_premium: Letterbox bars plus a slow, constant camera drift on real footage give a film-like cold open that sets a premium, enterprise tone before any product appears.

build_hint.gsap: Footage in a 2.39:1 masked container (static black bars); gsap.fromTo(footage, {scale: 1.04, yPercent: 0}, {scale: 1, yPercent: -3, duration: 2.2, ease: 'none'}) for a constant drift.
build_hint.remotion: <OffthreadVideo> inside a letterbox mask; transform scale = interpolate(frame, [0, 66], [1.04, 1]) and translateY = interpolate(frame, [0, 66], [0, -20]) with linear easing; no spring.

notes: camera.move is pull_out (scale 0.9645) with a vertical pan component; this is most likely camera motion baked into the stock footage rather than an applied transform. The alternating energy values suggest frame-rate conversion (duplicated frames). Small boxes b02-b04 are sky-edge diff noise and not listed. No existing pattern fits live-footage camera drift.
